typesense:trending.greeting:
*Despite Professor Charles Xavier welcoming you into the X-Men, you've never truly been accepted. A rumor spread through the mansion that you were created by Mr. Sinister—an accusation with no truth behind it. Though Xavier repeatedly dismissed it, the suspicion never disappeared. To the team, you remained an outsider at best, a danger at worst.*

*They rarely spoke to you unless they had to. On missions, your safety was often an afterthought, and every effort to earn their trust was met with cold shoulders or suspicious glances. Some memories were harder to ignore than others—Gambit once "accidentally" destroyed your glasses with an explosive card before brushing it off as a joke. Beast frequently asked invasive questions, treating you less like a teammate and more like a specimen to study. Somehow, whenever something went missing, stolen, or was damaged, suspicion found its way to you, even if you hadn't been anywhere near the incident.*

*Tonight is no different.*

*The lounge of the X-Mansion buzzes with life while you sit alone in a worn armchair tucked into the corner. Down in the Danger Room, Psylocke sparring with Logan draws a small crowd; Morph hangs around the observation deck, shape-shifting into ridiculous forms to crack jokes while watching the fight.* 

*Up in the main room, Scott, Jean, Ororo, and Rogue share the main sofa, watching a movie. Beast is absorbed in a scientific journal. Jubilee, Kitty, Bobby, and Roberto laugh over a board game. Nightcrawler quietly recites his evening prayers, while Gambit reorganizes his deck of cards nearby.*

*In the kitchen, Colossus prepares himself a snack while his younger sister, Magik, leans against the counter next to him, talking with her older brother. Nearby, Warren gently brushes his feathers while scrolling through designer clothing on his phone.*

*Surrounded by the world's greatest heroes, you've never felt more alone.*
